scope: Selected 19-context packet only, not full archive. English cases are primary; Chinese cases are separately reported probes because the site is presently English. No generative answer expected.

value.source_basis: 1992 u81–85 explains discounted future cash and margin of safety; 1994 u23 defines intrinsic value and interest/cash-flow sensitivity.

book.source_basis: 1994 u20–26 distinguishes book and intrinsic value, including the textile-asset and college-education examples.

owner.source_basis: 1986 u286–293 defines complete owner earnings, working-capital/LIFO qualification and maintenance-spending uncertainty.

accounting.source_basis: 1986 complete appendix u154–297 explains purchase-accounting changes in the same Scott Fetzer enterprise.

rates.source_basis: 1994 minimum-yield question and conditional discount-rate answer; 1998 ch8/44 common yardstick and knowability threshold. Historical conditions are not current recommendations.

risk_rate.source_basis: Full 1998 chapter44 explicitly refuses to compensate for an unknowable business merely with a higher discount rate.

growth.source_basis: 1992 u80/83 and 1998 ch8 distinguish productive reinvestment from forced low-return growth; 2000 cash-input/output discussion.

competence.source_basis: 1996 selected-business competence/boundary discussion; full 2002 questions/answers distinguish knowing transactions from knowing an enterprise.

finance.source_basis: 2002 ch18 paragraphs60–61 preserve uncertainty about continued finance-company funding independently of Berkshire credit.

confidence.source_basis: 2014 full chapter7 includes mistaken retail confidence, Baltimore department store and candid friends as feedback.

learning.source_basis: 2019 afternoon ch8: complete broad-generalist/narrow-specialist question, Buffett reading/research reply and Munger specialization reply.

expansion.source_basis: 2019 afternoon ch31: expand if you can, do not force it; energy learning from Walter Scott/Greg Abel remains below their expertise.

franchise.source_basis: 1991 u31–37 defines desired/no-close-substitute/unregulated economic franchise and distinguishes ordinary business economics.

sees.source_basis: 1991 u45–55 See’s historical pretax profits, reinvested equity, owner distributions and pricing power.

management.source_basis: 1989 u156–175 mistakes discussion includes management/business economics and institutional imperative.

prices.source_basis: 2013 p18–23 contrasts asset output with daily quotations, restless trading and helpful volatility; farm/NYU context preserved.

index.source_basis: 2013 p27–30 and 1996 index-fund paragraphs distinguish nonprofessional investors and low-cost diversified funds.

will.source_basis: 2013 p32 specific trustee instructions for wife: 90% low-cost S&P500/10% short-term government bonds. Not universal suitability.

farm.source_basis: 2013 original farm/NYU-property narrative bases return estimates on productive output, not price predictions.

loss.source_basis: 1994 ch13 allows conceivably no current after-tax cash, discusses GEICO losses, future earning power and degree of certainty.

uncertainty.source_basis: 2000 discussion says precise forecasts are foolish, ranges often too wide, and speculation differs from investing.

investor_habits.source_basis: 1996 original Common Stock Investments section gives inactivity, business quality, sensible price and competence limits; 2013 investing discussion contrasts asset output and speculation/quotation reaction; 2019 ch8 discusses research, knowledge advantages, specialization and patience. These sources supply relevant historical principles, not a guarantee of greatness.
